title: NY Mayor Zohran Mamdani Refuses to “Reset Expectations” in Rousing Inaugural Address: “I Will Not Abandon My Principles for Fear of Being Radical”
summary: The event at City Hall in Lower Manhattan featured performances from Lucy Dacus, Javier Muñoz and Mandy Patinkin, joined by a Staten Island children's chorus, as well as a reference to rapper Jadakiss.
